## Your Trusted Local Pool Repair Service Since 2007

Last spring, our neighbors called us in a panic. Their pool contractor had abandoned their half-finished project, leaving behind a muddy hole and broken promises. Three weeks later, we had them swimming in their dream custom concrete pool. This happens more than you’d think in Dallas, PA.

SpringLake Pools & Masonry has been building custom concrete pools in Dallas, Pennsylvania for over a decade. We know every inch of Luzerne County soil, from the rocky terrain near Harvey’s Lake to the clay deposits in Back Mountain. Our family business has created over 300 pools for families throughout Dallas, Shavertown, Trucksville, and surrounding communities.

When you’re searching for “pool builders near me” or “custom concrete pools Dallas PA,” you want someone who actually lives here. We’re not some big corporation from Scranton or Wilkes-Barre. Our kids go to Dallas School District. We shop at Gerrity’s. We know which streets flood during spring melt and which neighborhoods have the trickiest utility lines.

[Request Repair Quote](https://springlakepools.com/pool-repair-service/#consult)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/emergency-pool-repair-dallas-pa-1024x956.jpg)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/pool-replastering-dallas-pa.jpg)

### Pool Resurfacing

Pool resurfacing becomes necessary after 10-15 years in Pennsylvania weather. Freeze-thaw cycles crack plaster and create rough surfaces. Pool replastering restores your pool’s smooth finish and stops small leaks.

[Pool Resurfacing](https://springlakepools.com/pool-resurfacing/)

### Pool Replastering

We use premium plaster that resists algae and chemical staining. Our plasterers have worked together for over 8 years. They know how to handle Dallas’s hard water and temperature extremes.

[Pool Replastering](https://springlakepools.com/pool-replastering/)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/pool-tile-replacement-dallas-pa.jpg)

### Pool Tile Replacement

Pool tile replacement fixes the most visible part of aging pools. Waterline tiles take the most abuse from weather and chemicals. We stock popular tile styles or can match your existing pattern.

[Pool Tile Replacement](https://springlakepools.com/pool-tile-replacement/)

### Pool Coping Repair

Pool coping repair addresses the stone or concrete around your pool’s edge. Cracked coping lets water seep behind your pool shell, causing expensive damage. We catch these problems early during routine maintenance.

[Pool Coping Repair](https://springlakepools.com/pool-coping-repair/)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/pool-leak-detection-dallas-pa.jpg)

### Pool Leak Detection

Pool leak detection requires special equipment and experience. We use electronic listening devices and pressure testing to find leaks in pool shells, plumbing lines, and equipment. Most leaks happen at pipe joints or where plumbing enters the pool.

[Pool Leak Detection](https://springlakepools.com/concrete-pool-builder/)

## Additional services

If your pool has a problem, we can solve it! SpringLake Pools works closely with you to restore your pool to the condition that fits your family’s needs and brings back the reliability you expect from your backyard investment.

## Service Areas Throughout Northeastern Pennsylvania

We serve [Dallas](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-dallas-pa/), [Back Mountain](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-back-mountain-pa/), Shavertown, [Bear Creek](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-bear-creek-pa/), Trucksville, [Mountain Top](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-mountain-top-pa/), and surrounding communities in Luzerne County. Our crews also work in [Clarks Summit](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-clarks-summit-pa/), [Wilkes Barre](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-wilkes-barre-pa/), Waverly, and other parts of Lackawanna County.

From Harvey’s Lake to Sweet Valley, from Tunkhannock to the Poconos ( [Tannersville](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-tannersville-pa/) and [Blakeslee](https://springlakepools.com/service-areas/pool-builder-blakeslee-pa/)) we know the terrain, soil conditions, and local requirements. Every area has different challenges for pool construction and service.

[Learn More](https://springlakepools.com/services/)
